events.subtitle: TRIBUTES Release Live 2027
events.category: Japanese jazz / Tribute-album release / Flugelhorn and voice
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents TOKU's TRIBUTES release live on Wednesday, February 3, 2027, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM and doors at 5:00 PM and 7:45 PM. The official page identifies this as TOKU's first full album in six years and states that the material pays tribute to Miles Davis in his centennial year and to TOKU's late colleagues Roy Hargrove and Hisatsugu Suzuki. The seven-person recording-member lineup is TOKU, Akira Ishii, Hideaki Kanazawa, Shun Ishiwaka, Yosuke Onuma, James Macaulay and Akihiro Yoshimoto. The music charge is ¥8,500 before seat-specific charges; member reservations begin November 19 and general web reservations November 26.

en.why_it_matters: This is more specific than an album-release booking: TOKU brings the recording septet into one room to connect Miles Davis's centennial with personal memorials for Roy Hargrove and Hisatsugu Suzuki. Flugelhorn and voice sit inside a broad acoustic palette—guitar, piano, bass, drums, trombone and tenor saxophone—so the tribute has an ensemble argument rather than relying on repertoire labels alone.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if Tokyo is in the February plan and the thread includes Japanese jazz lineage, flugelhorn or memorial repertory. Two sets and an active band keep the recommendation below a scarcity claim that would justify reorganizing the trip.

es.why_it_matters: Es más específico que una simple presentación de disco: TOKU lleva al escenario al septeto de la grabación para unir el centenario de Miles Davis con homenajes personales a Roy Hargrove y Hisatsugu Suzuki. Flugelhorn y voz quedan dentro de una paleta acústica amplia —guitarra, piano, bajo, batería, trombón y saxo tenor—, así que el tributo tiene un argumento de ensamble y no depende sólo de los nombres del repertorio.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets si Tokio ya está en el plan de febrero y el hilo incluye linaje del jazz japonés, flugelhorn o repertorio memorial. Dos funciones y una banda activa no sostienen una escasez que justifique reorganizar el viaje.

events.subtitle: Jobim centennial and Ryuichi Sakamoto tribute — with Lisa Ono and Miu Sakamoto
events.category: Brazil-Japan lineage / Jobim centennial / Ryuichi Sakamoto tribute
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Goro Ito, Paula Morelenbaum and Jaques Morelenbaum on March 4-5, 2027, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night and doors at 5:00 PM and 7:45 PM. March 4 marks the centennial of Antônio Carlos Jobim's birth with guest Lisa Ono. March 5 celebrates the release of TREE, FORESTS tribute to RYUICHI SAKAMOTO with guest Miu Sakamoto. The core ensemble also includes Keita Ogawa, Koichi Sato, Manami Kakudo and Aya Ito. The music charge is ¥11,000 before seat-specific charges; member reservations begin November 22 and general web reservations November 29.

en.why_it_matters: The two-night design makes the lineage audible rather than merely commemorative. Ito and the Morelenbaums connect Jobim's Brazilian songbook to their own history with Ryuichi Sakamoto, then change the focal voice from Lisa Ono on the centennial night to Miu Sakamoto on the album-release night. Cello, violin, guitar, piano and layered percussion give the program a chamber-Brazilian palette that is unusually exact for this repertoire.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the night whose theme matters more—Jobim with Lisa Ono on March 4 or Sakamoto with Miu Sakamoto on March 5. The paired run and four total sets make A+ sufficient; the evidence does not require rebuilding a Japan itinerary around it.

es.why_it_matters: El diseño de dos noches vuelve audible el linaje en vez de limitarse a conmemorarlo. Ito y los Morelenbaum conectan el cancionero brasileño de Jobim con su propia historia junto a Ryuichi Sakamoto y cambian la voz focal: Lisa Ono en la noche del centenario y Miu Sakamoto en la presentación del álbum. Cello, violín, guitarra, piano y capas de percusión le dan al programa una paleta brasileña de cámara inusualmente precisa.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio activamente a la noche cuyo tema pese más: Jobim con Lisa Ono el 4 de marzo o Sakamoto con Miu Sakamoto el 5. La serie de dos noches y cuatro sets vuelve suficiente el A+; la evidencia no exige reconstruir un itinerario por Japón alrededor de ella.

events.subtitle: Nest-building-inspired quartet for acoustic bass, percussion, trumpet and alto flute/saxophone
events.category: DMV creative music / Modern jazz / Bass-led quartet
events.factual_description: Rhizome DC and Transparent Productions present Stephan Crump's Passerine on Saturday, November 21, 2026. Doors are at 7:00 PM and music starts at 7:30 PM. The quartet is Stephan Crump on acoustic bass, Ches Smith on percussion, Kenny Warren on trumpet and David Leon on alto flute and saxophone. The music is inspired by birds' different nest-building techniques and follows the October 23 release of the quartet's first album. Rhizome lists a $25-$30 sliding-scale face price; its authorized ticket page showed fee-inclusive totals of $27.74-$33.01 and was marked sold out when checked November 13.

en.why_it_matters: Passerine has a concrete compositional engine: Crump turns different nest-building strategies into ensemble form, and the quartet answers with an unusually open palette of acoustic bass, percussion, trumpet, alto flute and saxophone. Ches Smith, Kenny Warren and David Leon make the interest the live negotiation of that idea in Rhizome's close room, not simply an album-tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: If access opens and Saturday is free in the DMV, this is a strong Rhizome choice for new acoustic music and unusual instrumental balance. The project is touring regionally and the current ticket surface is sold out, so I would not displace a stronger commitment or build a corridor trip around it.

es.why_it_matters: Passerine tiene un motor compositivo concreto: Crump convierte distintas estrategias para construir nidos en forma de ensamble, y el cuarteto responde con una paleta muy abierta de contrabajo, percusión, trompeta, flauta alto y saxofón. Ches Smith, Kenny Warren y David Leon hacen que el interés sea la negociación en vivo de esa idea dentro de la sala cercana de Rhizome, no sólo una parada de gira de un disco.
es.trip_verdict: Si aparece acceso y el sábado está libre en el DMV, es una muy buena elección en Rhizome para música acústica nueva y balance instrumental poco común. El proyecto está girando por la región y la boletería figura agotada, así que no desplazaría un compromiso más fuerte ni armaría un viaje por el corredor alrededor de esta fecha.

events.factual_description: Mr. Henry's presents the Todd Marcus Quartet upstairs on Saturday, December 12, 2026. Doors are at 7:00 PM and the performance begins at 8:00 PM. The official venue page lists a $25 ticket, while authorized InstantSeats adds $2.58 in fees and states a $15 food-and-beverage minimum. The verified pages identify Marcus's focus on bass clarinet and the Middle Eastern influence of his Egyptian-American heritage but do not name the other three quartet members, so they are not inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The specific draw is Marcus treating bass clarinet as a lead voice inside hard-swinging modern jazz rather than a specialty color. His writing also lets Egyptian-American melodic influence enter a straight-ahead language without turning the set into a generic fusion label; the small upstairs room should keep that low-register detail close.
en.trip_verdict: Worth choosing if December 12 is open in the DMV and bass clarinet or locally rooted composition is the thread. The quartet personnel are not fully announced and Marcus is an active regional leader, so convenience and musical fit should decide rather than moving other plans.

es.why_it_matters: El atractivo específico es escuchar a Marcus tratar el clarinete bajo como voz principal dentro de un jazz moderno que swinguea con fuerza, no como color especial. Su escritura también deja entrar influencia melódica egipcio-estadounidense en un lenguaje straight-ahead sin reducir el set a una etiqueta genérica de fusión; la sala pequeña de arriba debería conservar de cerca ese detalle del registro grave.

La formación completa no está anunciada y Marcus es un líder regional activo, así que decidiría por conveniencia y afinidad musical, sin mover otros planes.
